title: Denton Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Denton Central Appraisal District · Website data downloads
intro: Everything we keep from Denton CAD's Data Downloads page: the 2026 PACS Appraisal Export in two snapshots (the certified roll of July 27 and supplement 3 of October 14), the 2026 certified JSON export flattened into one table per list, the ProTax protest exports for 2022–2024, and the agent files of the 2024 and 2025 exports. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions.
foot: Generated {date}. Files were scanned in full with DuckDB from the CSVs that etl/denton_appraisal_export_etl.ipynb writes from the raw PACS .TXT files; "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros. Personal contact fields beyond the CAD's own public values are never shown.

c26-info.label: Jul 27 · certified
c26-info.about: One row per property and owner: owner and mailing address, situs, legal description, land/improvement/market/appraised values, exemptions with qualify years, agents and ARB flags.
notes: Every number is zero-padded text (000000000070931); the page profiles value columns as numbers, but load them as text or cast them yourself. prop_id is 12 digits with leading zeros.
483,195 rows for 481,983 distinct prop_id: a property with several owners (undivided interest) has one row per owner, so the key is prop_id + py_owner_id.
legal_acreage and land_acres carry 4 implied decimals (1865 = 0.1865 acres).
No agent is written 000000000000, not blank: 128,204 rows have an appraisal agent (ca_agent_id) and 141,021 an ARB agent; every one of them is in the Agents file. arb_protest_flag is T on 4,399 rows.

unmapped_tail holds the fields Denton's PACS export 8.0.33 adds past the published 8.0.30 layout (18 distinct values, flag groups). deed_dt is MM-DD-YYYY and has 20 typo years before 1850 (e.g. 0006).
